source_phrase: type-name shall be the name of an accessible derived type.
If module-nature is INTRINSIC, module-name shall be the name of an intrinsic module.
If module-nature is NON_INTRINSIC, module-name shall be the name of a nonintrinsic module.
A procedure-name shall be a generic name or the name of a procedure.
Named constants in scalar-expr shall have been declared earlier in the scoping unit or made accessible by use
A given dummy-arg-name shall not appear more than once in a given dummy-arg-name-list.
